scope: Three FeeShare setup handlers; pinned current executable versus current Rust candidate, isolated local VM
limits: Initialize uses a disposable DAO mint signer and later captured funding mint; InitWithLegacy locally removes an already initialized destination, with explicit synthetic legacy-account variants; ChangeCreator operator positives lack a valid operator signature and are simulated only with sigverify disabled. Outcomes and complete watched account poststates are compared; compute units and log wording are recorded but not treated as equal. This does not establish all branches, historical prestate, live authority possession, exact source or a fund-risk vulnerability. No live transaction, keys, or funds.
